g.text: SOF Hostless Static Audio Pipeline Graph (DAG)
Component Declarations, Intermediate Ring Buffers, Kcontrol Interconnects & Binary Calibration Injection
Pipeline 1 (Playback): USB / Bluetooth Endpoint → Volume → Parametric IIR EQ → DRC Limiter → Physical DAI (I2S / SAI)
Pipeline 2 (Capture): Physical Ingress DAI (I2S / PDM) → TDFB Beamformer → Parametric EQ → Volume → USB / BT Host
